# PRESS ROOM [italic]Statements, appearances and the colony visit schedule of the Executive Vice President. Accredited press may request interviews through the Gateway office.[/italic]
## LATEST STATEMENTS - [bold]Record quarter for the Colonial Development Division.[/bold] Ninety-eight point seven percent of colonies reported on schedule. Ms. Varga-Ishikawa thanked every colonist by name, which took the communications office four days to arrange. - [bold]Thirty relay buoys approved.[/bold] The first ten will be laid along the Outer Veil this year. Colonies on the new routes can expect their relay mail roughly a week sooner. - [bold]Clinic partnership renewed.[/bold] The Division and Lasalle Bionational have renewed the frontier clinic agreement for a further ten years. Dispensaries will carry a standard Lasalle stock list across all Division colonies. - [bold]On recent relay rumours.[/bold] The Office does not respond to anonymous postings, to tabloid speculation or to the so called independent truth sites. Colonists with genuine concerns should raise them with their colony administration.
## COLONY VISIT SCHEDULE [italic]Ms. Varga-Ishikawa visits at least twelve colonies a year in person. Dates are subject to transit and security conditions.[/italic] - [bold]83.04.18[/bold] Gateway Station. The Fifty Who Build dinner. Black tie, no speeches longer than six minutes, by her request. - [bold]83.05.30[/bold] Oxley's Butte. A tour of the dam and the colony school. - [bold]83.07.02[/bold] Hope's Retreat. Opening of the new hydroponics wing. - [bold]83.08.21[/bold] Barker's Lament. A town meeting in the colony canteen. Questions will be taken from the floor. - [bold]83.10.11[/bold] Solaris Ridge. [color=#9A2A2A]POSTPONED[/color] on the advice of the Colonial Marines garrison. A new date will be announced. - [bold]83.11.26[/bold] {colony}. To be confirmed. If your colony administration would like a visit, the Office would like to hear from them.
## SHE SAID IT - On her management style: I read every report. Then I go and look. - On the frontier: The frontier is not a place. It is a schedule that has not been met yet. - On the violin: Please stop asking me to play at dinners. The people who ask have not heard me.
## PRESS CONTACTS Office of the Executive Vice President, Colonial Development Division, Weyland-Yutani Tower, Gateway Station. Interview requests take six to eight weeks. Requests from the Colony Tattler are not answered.
